europe_now.title: King of Spain Visits Ceuta
europe_now.summary: King Felipe VI visited Ceuta, declaring that the territory is an inalienable part of Spain amid ongoing diplomatic tensions with Morocco concerning migration.

sources.headline: King of Spain in Ceuta: ‘Sovereignty and territorial integrity are not negotiable, and faced with any risk, our duty is their defense’

europe_now.title: Nationwide Student Demonstrations in France
europe_now.summary: Tens of thousands of students and youth rallied across France in ongoing protests concerning education conditions and government policies, resulting in clashes in Paris.

top_stories.title: European Reactions to US Policy and Russia
top_stories.summary: European allies have raised concerns regarding recent US actions, including a diesel deal with Russia that has drawn parliamentary and diplomatic scrutiny. Lawmakers and officials argue that Western partners must maintain unified pressure and preserve strategic leverage against Moscow.

top_stories.title: EU Migration Strategy and External Partnerships
top_stories.summary: European leaders continue to debate union stability and migration management through financial arrangements with North African nations. Ursula von der Leyen pledged additional funding to regional regimes to manage migration flows toward Europe.
